19 | Spell Shield True | caster | C | self | U

30 | Channeling Resistance | caster | C | self | U
50 | Resistance True | caster | C | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the caster and adds 5 to all
of the caster’s RRs vs. spells.
@@ 2
When the caster is a target of a Mentalism spell, the “incoming” spell must
first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. For RR purposes, each spell
uses a level equal its caster's level. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR,
it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell
has no effect on this target.
@@ 4
As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from the realm of Essence.
@@ 5
As Protection I, except bonuses are 10.
@@ 6
As Cancel Mentalism, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.
@@ 8
Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster. The shield subtracts 10
from all frontal Mentalism attack rolls on the caster (base and elemental). In
addition, if the caster performs no other actions during a round, he can
“parry” (as with a normal shield) one spell attack. The parry bonus is equal
to 10 plus the caster’s skill rank with this spell list.
@@ 10
As Mind Shield, except is effective only against Essence spells.
@@ 11
As Protection I, except bonuses are 15.
@@ 13
As Mind Shield, except is effective only against Channeling spells.
@@ 15
As Mind Shield, except it is effective against any two of the three realms.
@@ 17
As Protection I, except bonuses are 25.
@@ 19
As Mind Shield, except is effective against all spells.
@@ 20
Gives a special bonus of +50 to all RRs against all Mentalism spells.
@@ 25
As Mind Resistance, except is only effective against Essence spells.
@@ 30
As Mind Resistance, except is only effective against Channeling spells.
@@ 50
As Mind Resistance, except is effective against two of the three realms.
